title: OpenAI Agent Builder is shutting down: How to export your workflows and move to Zapier
summary: OpenAI is shutting down Agent Builder on November 30. Here's how to export your workflow and rebuild it as a Zap, plus the best Agent Builder alternatives.
body_markdown:
**Agent Builder node**


**What it does**


**What it becomes in Zapier**


**Start**


Defines the workflow's inputs, like a user's chat message


A trigger. Instead of waiting for a chat message, you can start from an app event, a schedule, or a webhook


**Agent**


Holds instructions, tools, and model settings


An[AI by Zapier](https://zapier.com/blog/ai-by-zapier-guide/) step. Paste in the agent's instructions, pick from ~40 AI models, and give it the tools it needs


**Note**


Leaves comments for you and your team


Carry over the useful notes in step names or the Zap's description


**File search**


Retrieves data from vector stores you created on OpenAI's platform


A knowledge source on your AI step, or a[Zapier Table](https://zapier.com/tables) for structured data.


**Guardrails**


Checks for PII, jailbreaks, hallucinations, and other misuse


[AI Guardrails by Zapier](https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/sections/43960332382733-AI-Guardrails-by-Zapier) , followed by a filter or path that decides what happens on a failure


**MCP**


Calls third-party tools and services


Example: an MCP node connecting Gmail


A regular app step


Example: a Gmail step with its own authentication


**If/else**


Branches on a custom expression


[Paths](https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/8496288555917-Add-branching-logic-to-Zap-workflows-with-Paths) , or a[filter](https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/8496276332557-Add-conditions-to-Zap-workflows-with-filters) if one of the branches just ends the workflow


**While**


Loops while a condition stays true


The closest match is[Looping by Zapier](https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/42969233918477-Understanding-Looping-by-Zapier) , which repeats actions for every item in a list


**Human approval**


Pauses for an end user to approve before continuing


A[Human in the Loop](https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/sections/38731226552845-Human-in-the-Loop) step


**Transform**


Reshapes outputs, like object to array


[Formatter by Zapier](https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/16720031282189-Use-Formatter-with-AI-to-automatically-format-data) , or[Code by Zapier](https://help.zapier.com/hc/en-us/articles/45405528551181-Using-Code-by-Zapier) for anything fiddly


**Set state**


Defines global variables for use across the workflow


Usually nothing, since every step's output is available to the steps after it; for values that need to survive between runs, use a Table
